_: Network profile of games for multiplayer over the Internet. DATA, not code: one source for the PWA (lobby quality gate) and the Cloud catalog. LOW_LATENCY_REQUIRED = the game's own radio protocol waits for replies inside very tight windows (measured on the DS: ~0-8 ms one-way works, ~10 borderline, beyond probably fails), NORMAL = tolerant, UNKNOWN = not measured (a prudent middle).

rules.note: Mario Party DS: Download Play and the lobby handshake are timing sensitive
